_comment: Small campaign: BackgroundSubtraction_CUDA only (history + varThreshold), against real supervised records via pipeoptimizer run-real (src/pipeoptimizer/plan.md step 2), not the synthetic generator. Value ranges reused as-is from sweep-6's already-vetted candidates (see param_ranges_sweep6.json) -- sweep-6 explored these on synthetic data; this campaign re-checks them against real, human-tagged footage instead. Everything else (gaussian kernel/sigma, morph, contour thresholds) stays fixed at data/simulation/pipelines/pipe-v4-base-sweep6.json's values -- pass that as --base-pipeline.

_fixed_params.note: Fixed in the base pipeline (pipelines/pipe-v4-base-sweep6.json), not varied here. Only 'values' arrays in this file are actually applied by pipe_config_gen -- a bare 'value' key is not read by the generator, so these must be baked into the base pipeline JSON, not just documented here.

pipeline.gaussian_kernel_size.rationale: sweep-5: weak but consistently unfavourable trend; k=3 was tightest/lowest violin

pipeline.gaussian_sigma_x.rationale: sweep-6 base default -- not swept here, this campaign is bg-subtraction-only

pipeline.bg_var_threshold.rationale: Reused verbatim from sweep-6 (synthetic): median plateau flat 16-64, worst-case tail grows past 64, 80 kept as a tail-risk sentinel.

pipeline.bg_history.rationale: Reused verbatim from sweep-6 (synthetic): shifted window to find the plateau above the confirmed-worse 500/1000 floor.
